alternatives.root_cause: payment itself became slow from internal resource exhaustion
alternatives.why_not: payment's own server spans complete in well under 1.2ms; the latency is entirely in checkout's client span self-time, i.e. before payment's handler is entered

alternatives.root_cause: payment was cut off from the network
alternatives.why_not: calls still succeed and return in ~300ms with no errors; a partition would hang to deadlines and produce unreachability complaints, not a fixed uniform delay

alternatives.root_cause: a wrong configuration value in checkout pointed it at a slow payment endpoint
alternatives.why_not: no change was observed on checkout and the delay matches exactly the 300ms shaping value recorded against payment's network namespace

verdict.summary: A traffic-shaping container attached to payment's network namespace at 01:16 injecting a 300ms link delay, so every checkout->payment call waits ~300ms while payment itself serves in under a millisecond.
verdict.reasoning: checkout alerted but shows zero error ratio (tr_bda83c006c85) and no log lines (tr_6e2c94bc096a) - it is slow, not broken. Every sampled trace (tr_2513afb166c2) has the same degrading hop: checkout's client span to oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge takes ~302-306ms with nearly all of it as self-time, while the payment server span and payment/charge complete in under 1.2ms. That signature is time spent on the wire, not in payment's handler. The change log for payment (tr_f12577128140) shows platform-automation attaching a traffic-shaping container with eth0 delay=300ms at 01:16:18, just before the 01:21:31 onset, and an identical earlier attach/remove pair hours before. The delay is inserted into the call path, so the failing mechanism is dependency latency; remediation is to revert that injected network setting by removing the shaping container.
open_questions: Whether the earlier 22:36-22:44 shaping episode produced a matching unreported slowdown, which would further confirm causality
Whether any upstream request ultimately timed out or failed for users, since no errors were observed in checkout's window
Why platform-automation attached the shaping container - deliberate experiment or misfired automation
